Case reference: 2014004616.CaseDesc: Beverly Fontaine was last seen by family in 1981 in Vancouver, British Columbia. Beverly was reported missing in May 2002. Beverly has not been seen or heard from since.

While being escorted to the North Bay Pyschiatric Hospital (now Northeast Mental Health Centre), he ran off into the wooded area.

Tattoo: Right Shoulder, Tribal art/Band around biceps

Case reference: 2014002692.CaseDesc: Between September 3 and October 3, 1978, Jean-Jacques Sirois was seen for the last time in the Rosemont District in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-Jacques has not been seen or heard from since.

Jewelry: Gold, Gold ring with rectangular cubic zirconia

Case reference: 2010003999.CaseDesc: During the evening of Friday May 28, 1999, Tammy Lamondin, age 20,  was with friends on Main Street in Newmarket. She remained in their company until sometime after midnight. In the early morning hours of May 29, 1999, Tammy left the Newmarket area with a male acquaintance. She was not seen again. The police conducted an investigation but were not able to locate her.

Tattoo: Right Ankle, Dolphin above right ankle

Case reference: 2014002023.CaseDesc: Lara Brown was reported missing to the Edmonton Police Service in September 1998.  Lara was last heard from by a friend at the end of August 1998.

Case reference: 2018053584.CaseDesc: On May 15, 1996, at approximately 1:30 p.m., Esther Adam was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Esther had made arrangements to meet with a friend on May 18, at 10:00 a.m., but did not attend.

Mark: Nose, Blue mark on bridge of nose

Case reference: 2014001425.CaseDesc: Terry Hrynick was reported missing by the manager of Sickle Lake Lodge in Manitoba in the early hours of August 3, 1986. He had spent the previous evening and early morning with friends. According to them, Terry had been very quiet in the days leading up to his disappearance. On the night of his disappearance, he was described as intoxicated. At one point, witnesses saw him stumble out the door of the cabin. About 15 minutes later, they heard a boat but did not see him. The empty boat was located the following day. An extensive search on land and water failed to find him. There was no indication that Terry found his way to shore and he has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014003051.CaseDesc: On May 11, 1991, Yanick Fortin, age 6, was last seen playing by himself in the backyard of the family residence in Matawin, Quebec. The backyard of the house overlooks the St. Maurice River. Searches were conducted in the area but Yanick was never seen again.

Case reference: 2022012676.CaseDesc: Sum Yee Li was last seen leaving her home in East Gwillimbury, Ontario on December 26, 2021. This is out of character for her, as she used to check in on her son on a frequent basis. She has been known to travel internationally and to Western Canada. It is believed that she was the victim of foul play due to the length of time she has been missing.

Case reference: 2020011478.CaseDesc: On November 15, 1988, Mary McCarthy was seen for the last time at her apartment in Toronto, Ontario. Mary’s vehicle was later found on November 17, 1988 at the bus depot in Niagara Falls, Ontario. Mary was a chartered accountant working for CSA Management Ltd. at the time of her disappearance.

Case reference: 2015018154.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1966, Delores Whiteman was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2012020137.CaseDesc: On Friday September 27, 1963, Diane Carrier left home and went to the neighbourhood park in the Old Quebec district of Quebec City, Quebec, to advise her brother to return home for dinner. Diane's brother returned home alone and Diane has never been seen since.

Case reference: 2014001277.CaseDesc: On July 26, 1987, Sukhminder Singh Grewal was last seen in Richmond, British Columbia. He came to Canada and performed as a singer in an East Indian Music Troupe that toured across the country. Sukhminder has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014004759.CaseDesc: On March 21st 2006, Tayven Bear was playing with two other children on the ice of the Churchill River in Sandy Bay, Saskatchewan. Tayven fell into the river and he was never recovered.

Case reference: 2020009578.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1989, at approximately 1:00am, Andrew Gunzinger was seen for the last time leaving his girlfriend’s father’s farm near Orangeville, Ontario. Prior to leaving, Andrew and his girlfriend had gotten into a dispute.

Case reference: 2025007526.CaseDesc: On January 10, 2007, Nancy Morton went to the South Division of the South Simcoe Police Service.  She requested that the police accompany her to her former residence in Bradford, Ontario, so that she could retrieve some belongings. Nancy had been away for several years when she unexpectedly returned to Ontario, which caused problems with her spouse and children.  She was visiting from Oklahoma, USA.  As officers were unavailable to assist her, she left the station and hasn’t been seen since.

Mark: Right Thigh, Birthmark on inner thigh.

Case reference: 2014000008.CaseDesc: On February 2, 2008, Christopher Hargitt, a resident of Vernon, BC, drove from Vernon to Vancouver. He was last seen by an associate, who was dropped off by Mr. Hargitt near the PNE Fairgrounds. On March 6, 2008, Christopher's vehicle was found unoccupied in East Vancouver, and he has made no contact with family or friends since that time. It is believed that Christopher may have run afoul of individuals involved in criminal activity, or fled the country to avoid these same persons.

Case reference: 2006012999.CaseDesc: Joshua Kennett was last seen in the water following the capsizing of the vessel he was travelling in on Grayson Lake, Ontario, on 13 October 1995. It is presumed that Joshua drowned.

Case reference: 2014002002.CaseDesc: On September 17, 1977, Gaetan Pichette was seen for the last time in the Verdun district of Montreal, Quebec. His family and friends have not seen or heard from him since.

Tattoo: Right Arm, Arm tattoo, inscribed with "COCU"

Case reference: 2014001632.CaseDesc: Elizabeth Dorion was last seen by a friend at a local fishing camp in Pukatawagan, Manitoba on September 21, 1999. She arrived at the fishing camp on September 17th with her friends and stayed there for approximately 4 days. She was never seen again. Searches of the area, including several steep embankments and the immediate vicinity of the camp, yielded no significant findings. Elizabeth's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2008018099.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1974, at approximately 8:15 hours, Douglas Henderson and Alexander Korecki were canoeing in a 14 foot fiberglass canoe close to the shore in the area of Depot Harbor, Big Sound, in Georgian Bay. The canoe capsized approximately 500 feet away from the campsite.

Case reference: 2014001617.CaseDesc: On January 25, 1976, Camille Lessard was last seen in Montreal, Quebec. Camille regularly went to a tavern located on the corner of Avenue Papineau and Sainte-Catherine East street in the Le Village district of Montreal, Quebec. Camille suffers from memory loss.

Case reference: 2020008878.CaseDesc: On September 19, 1979, Joseph Vetere was seen for the last time in the area of 1061, Weston Road in Toronto, Ontario.

Tattoo: Left Forearm, A penny with the initials "T.W."
Left Upper Arm, Bear on a rock

Case reference: 2016061231.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1968, an unidentified male was found hanging in a hotel room. He had checked in under the name Henry Drendorf. No identification was found. This individual was found with several bags of architectural books.

Case reference: 2014002449.CaseDesc: On July 27, 1997, Mike Tsannie was last seen traveling by boat across Wollaston Lake near Hungry Island, Saskatchewan. Mike's boat was later found unoccupied, and searches failed to locate any trace of him.

Case reference: 2022048184.CaseDesc: Vatsal Rabari was last seen at a rest area in the Parc des Laurentides, in Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury, Quebec, on September 19, 2022. Vatsal was reported missing to police on September 25, 2022 when family and friends received a postdated email indicating that he was feeling despondent. Vatsal had recently resigned from his job and had previously lived in the provinces of Ontario and Nova Scotia before settling in Quebec.

Case reference: 2021037317.CaseDesc: On 18 August, 2021, Kari Campbell was seen for the last time in the Durham Bridge region of York County, New Brunswick. Kari has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003825.CaseDesc: Ruby Ann Hardy was reported missing by her brother in 2002. She was last seen in the downtown east side of Vancouver in June 1997, and was engaged in a high risk lifestyle.

Case reference: 2014002416.CaseDesc: On May 5, 1983, Desmond Runstedler was believed to be travelling to Ontario and was last seen standing on the side of Highway #13 near Lougheed, AB.  His personal items were left at his residence.

Case reference: 2014001853.CaseDesc: On May 19, 1958, Clifford McKell and a friend were last seen eating dinner and telling friends they were going canoeing on Snow Lake Manitoba. Neither man was considered an experienced paddler. No one saw the men leave in the canoe. The following day they were reported missing by their employer when they failed to report to work. The police began an investigation and an aerial search located the overturned canoe. Paddles and safety cushions were also found. A witness who saw two men in a canoe at around 8.30 p.m. stated that they were heading south and the lake was quite rough at the time. Clifford is believed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2014003567.CaseDesc: On November 24, 2001, Jocelyn Gadoury was seen for the last time when he left his home in Laval, Quebec to go to his garage in Saint-Eustache, Quebec. Jocelyn has not been seen or heard from since.

Sweater: White, T Shirt, text "Patron de Zapet"

Case reference: 2014032043.CaseDesc:
On May 22nd, 1970, Philomena Sisson, age 68, was reported missing by her son, Harry Jack.  She had gone missing a few days earlier from his house on Boys Rd. in Duncan, BC.  Mrs. Sisson was reported to be an alcoholic who occasionally went missing for several days at a time. She also suffered from dementia. 
 
Mrs. Sisson's last surviving son has since passed away.  There was never any indication of foul play in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014002868.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1989, Ronald Jack last spoke with his mother. During that telephone discussion, Ronald had informed her that he and his wife, Doreen Jack, would be leaving for a “camp job”. He had also said that they would be gone for approximately 10 days, and would be back before their sons, Russell and Ryan Jack, started their school year in September.

Case reference: 2014005133.CaseDesc: On August 4, 2008, Laventus Burke was seen for the last time in St. Albans, Newfoundland and Labrador. During the time of his disappearance, Laventus had left a note for his mother indicating that he was going to travel to Alberta for work, and then would be moving to Florida, in the United States of America.

Case reference: 2019015560.CaseDesc: On March 26, 2019, Donna Paré was reported missing in Montreal, Quebec. Donna last communicated with her family in December 2018, and is known to live a transient lifestyle. She is known to frequent the Berri-UQAM and Place-des-Arts metro stations, and the McDonald’s on Sainte-Catherine Street East and Berri Park in Montreal, Quebec. Donna’s family has reason to fear for her health and safety.

Case reference: 2014003643.CaseDesc: Dean Mortensen was reported missing on January 24, 1992, after he failed to attend his classes at the University of Alberta in Edmonton, Alberta. Dean was last seen by his friends leaving the on campus bar, The Ship. They parted ways with him within 200 metres of his dorm room at the St. Joseph's College that night.

Jacket: Grande Cache Bantam Elks leather hockey jacket with gold shoulders, white collar, "Dean" on sleeve
Shirt: ST JOSEPH, St. Joseph crest on front

Case reference: 2014002864.CaseDesc: Mark Garland was reported missing on November 26, 1996, to the Durham Regional Police Service.  It is believed that he went missing from Toronto, Ontario and foul play has not been ruled out.

Case reference: 2014006199.CaseDesc: Albert Riddy went missing from his residence between April 5 and July 30, 2013. We have not been able to locate him since. The circumstances surrounding his disappearance are considered suspicious.

The investigation concluded that Natasha Klok was an occupant of that vehicle and that she went into a nearby heavily forested area. Natasha has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002009.CaseDesc: Leroy Marshall, AKA Roy Marshall, has been missing since July 23, 1979 from Saint John, New Brunswick. Leroy moved in with his sister on the west side of Saint John in June of 1979. Leroy had a job interview with the school district on July 23, 1979 but failed to show. Leroy previously lived in Somerville, Massachusetts, United States of America, between 1961 and 1971.

Case reference: 2008021099.CaseDesc: On September 17, 1966, Diane Prevost was seen for the last time as she was camping at Grundy Provincial Park in Britt, Ontario. Case reference: 2013000021.CaseDesc: Bones of a right foot with its sock and shoe were found along the bank of the Ottawa river in Gatineau, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014005595.CaseDesc:
On April 17, 2011, at approximately 5:00 p.m., Sarah Davis was seen for the last time as she left the 
Juliette’s Place shelter in Toronto, Ontario. Sarah had gone there to retrieve her personal belongings.

Case reference: 2014003708.CaseDesc: John Kane was last seen March 29, 1994, when he left his residence to go to work at the Saint John Regional Hospital in Saint John, New Brunswick. John never arrived for his shift, which was unusual for him. John would become depressed when drinking, and threatened suicide in the past. He was known to be a heavy drinker and gambler.

Case reference: 2014003107.CaseDesc: Jean Fournier was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on August 30, 1993. Jean was very stressed and depressed at the time of his disappearance and he left a letter for his wife stating that he was leaving all of his belongings to her. Jean left his house with little money in his pocket.

Case reference: 2014001691.CaseDesc: Norman Krolman was last seen withdrawing money from an ATM machine.  He was a self-employed computer programmer and was in business with a partner.  He had a steady girlfriend and a small circle of friends.

Case reference: 2022032399.CaseDesc: On May 25, 2022, partial skeletal remains of this man were found in a forested area near Salmon Arm, British Columbia. He had a severe fracture to his right lower leg during life, which required surgical intervention. He likely died many months to years before his remains were found.

Foreign Object: Right Leg, fracture to right tibia with surgical implant

Case reference: 2014002336.CaseDesc: On March 22, 1993, around 4:00 P.M. Yolande Bouchard was going to meet her sister at the mall in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Yolande never arrived and was reported missing at that time. Yolande's car was later found in Trois-Rivières West with two offence tickets on the windshield.

Case reference: 2021022554.CaseDesc: Muoi Nguyen was last seen on January 5, 1990 and was reported missing on January 12, 1990. Police have not been able to locate Muoi.

Case reference: 2012020110.CaseDesc: On September 23 2000, Nathalie Godbout was seen for the last time in the Saint-Romuald district in Lévis, Quebec. Nathalie was the mother of two children.

Case reference: 2012020655.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2008, Wilson Grant Nokohoot was seen for the last time on the 1800 block of Smith Street, Regina, Saskatchewan. It is unusual for Wilson to not have regular contact with family and acquaintances.

Case reference: 2013000093.CaseDesc: On July 10, 1989, Arlene Gagne was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Arlene told her husband that she wanted to stay home for the day. When her husband came back, Arlene was not home. All of her personal belongings were left at home.

Case reference: 2014005425.CaseDesc: On March 22, 2010, at approximately 6:00 a.m., Tong-kok Lam was seen for the last time by her husband as he left their home to go to work. When Tong-kok’s husband returned, she and some of her personal belongings were gone.

Case reference: 2018034585.CaseDesc: On September 1, 2004, at approximately 8:00 am, Stephen Lawrence was seen for the last time leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Stephen had said he would be home in a few hours.

Case reference: 2014006747.CaseDesc: Jian Ping Li and her 6 month old baby, Xiao Feng Lu, were last seen at their family residence around 9:40 a.m in Brossard, Quebec on April 30, 2014.  When her husband returned that day, around 2:30 p.m., there was nobody home and the back door was unlocked.  Jian Ping Li's car was still at the residence, however she left without her purse, wallet, credit card, cell phone, money, as well as the diaper bag, the stroller and the car seat for the baby.

Case reference: 2013000046.CaseDesc: On June 27, 2004, Richard McGuire was seen for the last time in the Nouveau-Rosemont district of Montreal, Quebec. Richard's vehicle, a Ford Windstar, was later found in a garage located in the municipality of St-Elzear in the La Nouvelle-Beauce Regional County in Quebec.

Case reference: 2014003214.CaseDesc: On November 24, 1982, Clyde "Van" Ditmars was reported missing to the Thunder Bay Police Service by his family. Van sought work in British Columbia, Alberta and Manitoba in the early 1980s as a welder. Since being reported missing, Van's family has not heard from him and his whereabouts are unknown.

Abdomen, Surgical, horizontal on the left side

Case reference: 2014004294.CaseDesc: On May 28, 2001, Jean-Paul Leroux was seen for the last time when he left his spouse’s residence in Montreal, Quebec.  Jean-Paul's vehicle was located abandoned 7 days later in the parking lot of the Saint-Leonard shopping centre. Jean-Paul has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002565.CaseDesc: On July 5, 1975, Carl Gallen was employed as a steelworker on the Long Spruce Dam project. He and his partner were working on a cement wall near the river. Carl was drilling into the wall when he fell into the water. His partner stated that he went directly under the water and did not see him surface. Carl wasn't wearing a harness or lifejacket. It's presumed he drowned.

Case reference: 2006022899.CaseDesc: Eric  Schoenleber was last seen while fishing in a canoe on Innes Lake on May 16, 1972.

Case reference: 2014002978.CaseDesc: On June 6, 1982, a witness saw Louisette St-Arneault fall from the Laviolette Bridge in Trois-Rivières, Quebec. Her body was never recovered.

Case reference: 2025049755.CaseDesc: On July 23, 2025, US officials responded to the base of the North Grand Island Bridge in New York following a report of a boating accident on the Niagara River in Niagara Falls, New York.  Jerome Williams and another passenger were thrown overboard. The other occupant was eventually recovered but Jerome remains missing.

Case reference: 2025004300.CaseDesc: Vikas Sharma's last sighting was on January 25, 2025 in the area of Table Rock, Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Case reference: 2015020929.CaseDesc: On April 27, 2015, Andrzej Popek was last seen at the Crawford Lake Conservation Area in Milton, Ontario.  Andrzej's abandoned vehicle was located the following day in the Conservation's parking lot.

Case reference: 2014005971.CaseDesc: Mrs. Guifeng Tong was last seen on video surveillance at her apartment on January 16, 2013 at 0958hrs. She was known to frequent Crystal Mall, Lougheed Mall and Metrotown Mall. She also likes to pick mushrooms at numerous parks in the lower mainland.

Case reference: 1992003440.CaseDesc: On May 13, 1984, Daniel Worobec was last seen in Lanigan, Saskatchewan, where a witness stated that he had told them he was waiting for a ride. Despite extensive searches and investigations, Daniel has not been located.

Boots: Brown, Cowboy boots with square toes
Hat: Blue, White, Baseball cap with writing on it

Case reference: 2006017699.CaseDesc: Marianne Minor was a resident of the St. Thomas Psychiatric Hospital in 1984. She left her ward to go to the canteen and has never been seen again.

Case reference: 2012020055.CaseDesc:
The body of an Asian male was discovered by cleaning staff at the Northbrook Inn in Grand Rapids, Manitoba.  The individual had checked in at 15:30h after arriving on the bus from Winnipeg.  At 18:00h cleaning staff entered the room to find the occupant deceased in a chair.
It was learned that the subject checked into the hotel under the name "CHERON, Deoung".  A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Case reference: 2014005513.CaseDesc: Jayson Nakas was reported missing to the RCMP in Drayton Valley, Alberta, on June 30, 1995. Jayson fell off an inner tube in the North Saskatchewan River. His friends saw him go under the water, but did not see him come back up.  They were the last people to see him that day.

Case reference: 2014002901.CaseDesc: On January 26, 1981, Carlos Yuste was living with friends in Thompson, Manitoba. He left the residence and never returned. Carlos left behind all his clothes and personal belongings. His friends described him as feeling very depressed about his unemployment.

YUSTE GARCIA DE LOS RIOS, Carlos Manuel

Case reference: 2005006599.CaseDesc:
On September 18, 1978, the body of an unidentified man was found in the Toronto Harbour of Lake Ontario. His post-mortem weight was 163lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.
Staining on his teeth suggest that he may have been a smoker. It is estimated that he had been in the water for several weeks.

Teeth: Stained, Overbite & several amalgam fillings. Several teeth lost/extracted during life; lower right lateral incisor being most obvious.

Case reference: 2015059337.CaseDesc: On July 26, 2015, at approximately 10:30 p.m., Van Huong was last seen on vacation in Vietnam. The next morning, Van’s family noticed he had left the hotel room and had not returned.

Case reference: 2017073542.CaseDesc: On November 4, 2016, an unidentified man was discovered in Lake Ontario in St. Catharines, Ontario. Biogeographic ancestry testing predicts he was of East Asian Ancestry.

Case reference: 2014006270.CaseDesc: On September 25, 2013, Daniel Pierre was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. During the time of his disappearance, Daniel was driving a rented 2014 black Jeep Grand Cherokee, and was accompanied by his reddish brown, with a white chest, male pit-bull. The vehicle was subsequently located on the corner of Deguire Boulevard and Ashton Street in the Ville Saint-Laurent neighbourhood in Montreal. Daniel is a diabetic and depends on medication that is not in his possession.

Case reference: 2014004699.CaseDesc: On October 4, 2005, Veeravi Jeya Eskimuttu "VJ" was last seen leaving his place of employment in Saint John, New Brunswick. Veeravi is known to be a transient individual who has previously resided in Cornwall and Toronto, Ontario, as well as Montreal, Quebec, and Halifax, Nova Scotia.

There has been no use of his health or bank cards since that date.
